text:
maya_marketing: Heads-up: new product launch blog draft is live in Drive: https://drive.redwoodinference/launch_post_brand_voice.docx — need quick passes on voice, hero, and lead routing.
owen_product: Taking a look. Product asks: include a 2-sentence tech aside linking to Appendix B (benchmarks + methodology). Also want the hero to show the Dedicated dashboard with a clear latency tail.
tai_design: Uploaded hero crops: hero_live, hero_illustration, hero_overlay. My pick: hero_live for authenticity. Need square + wide exports.
nina_ops: For lead routing, we should add region + interest tags to the CTA link. Suggested UTM: ?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=launch_q2&utm_region={region}&interest={interest}. HubSpot mapping plan below.
- US -> Pipeline: Demo - US
- EU -> Pipeline: Demo - EU
- APAC -> Pipeline: Demo - APAC (fallback to US)
Also can add ctav param for CTA variant.
claire_legal: Legal notes: no absolute performance claims in H1. Use qualifiers (e.g., "up to"). Need partner logo release and written approval of sponsor blurb before publish.
partner_comms: Partner can provide logo + release today if we send the sponsor blurb now for review. Request a 24h courtesy preview before embargo lift.
maya_marketing: Draft sponsor sentence: "In partnership with [Partner], enabling enterprise-grade private deployments." Sending to partner. Also planning a small CTA AB test: ctav=book_demo vs ctav=request_trial (50/50).
ownen_product: Appendix B ETA: 4pm PT with raw csv + evaluation script link. I'll craft conservative phrasing around the numbers.
tai_design: Once Appendix is up, Ill export charts and social assets (PNG + SVG).
nina_ops: I'll provision region-aware demo rooms and set HubSpot webhook to attach UTMs and interest tags. ETA EOD. Will include experiment flag for CTAs.
claire_legal: I'll review Appendix + sponsor copy when posted. If partner assets are late, remove logo and use text mention.
pub-bot: Reminder: proposed embargo lift 2026-05-04 09:00 PT. Partner requested 24-hour preview. Final review scheduled 2026-05-01 14:00 PT: https://meet.redwoodinference/final-launch-review
maya_marketing: Timeline recap: partner assets + release by EOD today, Appendix B by 4pm PT, legal signoff by 6pm PT. Will post updated draft and tag final 60-min review window. Any objections? :thumbsup:
town: :thumbsup:
tai_design: :thumbsup:
claire_legal: :thumbsup: pending assets
partner_comms: Will push assets by 5pm PT and confirm preview window.
maya_marketing: Thanks all — will update the doc in an hour with CTAs and UTM examples and follow up here.
